'''Oren Dautry''' is a [[Westwood]] farmer and [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] and [[Tamlin al'Thor|Tam al'Thor]]'s closest neighbor. 

== Appearance ==
He is tall and lean.

== Activities ==
He [[Traveling|Travels]] through [[Jur Grady]]'s [[gateway]] to join the rest of the [[Two Rivers]] men recruited by [[Perrin Aybara]]. He participates in the [[Battle of Malden]].{{ref/book|11|29}}
